Package com.robojacks.lib.hardware

Class VexRotationSensor

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.hardware.VexRotationSensor
public class VexRotationSensor extends Object
V5 Rotation Sensor: an absolute encoder, like a REV Through Bore or CANcoder. Use it on an arm joint (absolute angle survives power cycles) or on an unpowered tracking wheel for odometry.

Positions are in rotations until you set a conversion factor, then in your units: 


 VexRotationSensor m_trackingWheel = new VexRotationSensor(kTrackingWheelPort);
 m_trackingWheel.setPositionConversionFactor(Math.PI * Units.inchesToMeters(2.0)); // meters
 double traveled = m_trackingWheel.getPosition();
